name: Unbreakable Items
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: wildbeast42
description: A Minecraft mod that disables item breaking. Tools and armor reach 0 durability, then lock until they're repaired, preserving enchanted gear.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-19 (aec290a0) (23 classes, 27 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
